title: Match the printf conversions to the argument types
summary: Fix a printf that passes size_t to %d, and a tag that is never terminated.

turns.user: report prints garbage numbers on the 64 bit box. gcc is also complaining about something

assistant.body: Three separate problems. count is a size_t so it wants %zu, total is a long so it wants %ld, and passing the wrong type to a conversion is undefined, not just ugly. On top of that tag only ever gets 4 bytes copied into it and is never terminated, so %s walks off the end of the array. Sizing it to hold a terminator and writing one defensively.

turns.user: oh right, tag was just the first 4 chars. scrap it, print the whole name. and I want bytes in hex

assistant.body: Then tag goes away entirely and name can go straight into %s at any length. Hex is %lx, but that is an unsigned conversion, so the argument should be an unsigned long to match. That way the type itself says the value is never negative.
